title.narrative: Mongolia HIV - Mongolia (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Mongolia, HIV, Ministry of Health of Mongolia (MOH Mongolia)This program has the following goals: To diminish the HIV prevalence among Key Affected Populations (KAP) and to prevent the spread of the epidemics among general population, through scaling up KAP friendly STI, HIV and AIDS treatment, care and services. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: To mitigate the HIV prevalence among key population through enhancing quality and access of the friendly HIV, AIDS and STI care and service. Objective 2: To strengthen HIV prevention and among vulnerable groups of the general populatio. Objective 3: To strengthen access to and quality of HIV/AIDS care and support services for people living with HIV. Objective 4: To strengthen the enabling environment of HIV, AIDS response with integrated corrdination ensured by multisectorial involvement. Objective 5: To strengthen the surveillance system aimed to provide the information necessary for implementation of evidence based interventions. Objective 6: Program management
